news.title: Researchers trace solar outbursts that led to historic Mother’s Day geomagnetic storm on Earth
news.summary_en: Physicists led by the University of Iowa have traced the solar activity that caused the 2024 Mother’s Day storms, which spawned auroras that may have been the strongest on record in 500 years. The researchers say 10 solar outbursts combined to form a gigantic magnetic cloud that created an intense geomagnetic storm on Earth.
